known_issues: Named APP-2 faculty, patient or caregiver, survey-methods, accessibility, language-access, privacy, responsible-AI, clinical, and independent reproduction reviews remain pending before alpha.
The teaching frame has complete coverage only because it is constructed from the analytic target.
The response, mode, Q21, Q22, Q23, and item-missingness fields are synthetic and cannot support real patient, hospital, HCAHPS, access, equity, prevalence, or causal claims.
The one-record missing-language response cell is retained as limited support and must not be interpreted.
The bounded adjustment improves known-truth error in the simulation but leaves residual bias for both items and the composite.
Design-aware uncertainty and linked analysis remain owned by Module 04, while machine-learning response modeling remains owned by Module 06.
No package authorizes fielding, patient targeting, clinical action, or hospital ranking.
An actual course section must map the module to the official half-term calendar before assigning a due date.
